name: Close Fighting
body:
You’ve trained long and hard with allies, mastering your combat techniques when shoulder-to-shoulder with your allies.

Benefit: When adjacent to an ally that possesses the Close Fighting feat you gain a bonus to attack and damage rolls equal to one-half your ally’s base attack bonus (round down).
